summary: ProgramDocument manages program-related documents including logos, consent forms, and general files. It facilitates adding, deleting, searching, and formatting these documents for display and emailing. It handles both business logic and file system operations for document lifecycle management.
purpose: To serve as the data and business logic layer for program-related documents in the HSPnet system. This includes CRUD operations, formatting, validation, searching, and updating program logos.

workflows.name: Add ProgramDocument
steps: Add parameters to DB: SessionID, ProgramDocumentID, ProgramID, TypeCodeID, DocumentName, TypeComments, FileURL, FilePath, FileSize, FileType
If TypeCodeID indicates Logo, clear procedure name, add Logo and ProgramID parameters, execute SQL update for ProgramLogos

workflows.name: Delete ProgramDocument
steps: If file exists, delete file and folder

workflows.name: Search ProgramDocuments
steps: Retrieve data and fill document list

workflows.name: Get Program Consent Forms
steps: Retrieve and return localized CodeRecord list

workflows.name: Format File Link and Email
steps: If FileURL is non-blank and file exists, format FileURL as HTML link
If Email exists, format as HTML mailto link

business_rules: TypeCodeID must not be 0 for validity (Type required)
Logo file update triggers update to ProgramLogos table
If alternative language fields are enabled, use alt-language values
calculations: FileSize converted to KBytes for display
conditions: If LogoOnly is true, retrieve only logos
If UseDepartmentLogo is true, retrieve department logo instead of program logo
If file not found, display 'no logo available' or 'document not found'
system_behavior: Document CRUD operations interact with DB procedures and file system
Exception handling for file/folder deletes (errors ignored)
Dynamic document and email formatting for UI
dependencies: CodeRecord for document types and consent forms
exceptions: File or directory deletion failures are ignored
If file not found, show default messages
content_gaps: The logic for other document types (besides program and department logos, consent forms) is not fully detailed.
UI and localization implementations are referenced but not elaborated.
Further workflow details for editing, viewing documents were not found.
